name: Better Late Than Never
summary: A ghostly woman asks you to deliver a package, but her directions are unclear.

sections.title: A Ghost's Request
sections.body: A ghostly woman says a package needs delivering, and you are left to make sense of her words. She claims it lies where her horse is, but neither the horse's whereabouts nor the package's destination is clear.

faq.answer: The ghostly woman says she needs a package delivered.
The woman says the package is where her horse is, but she does not make that place clear.

faq.q: Where does the package need to go?
faq.answer: The ghost's words do not make the package's destination clear.

attribution: In-game quest text: Better Late Than Never
